title: Hash map with collision chains
summary: Build a fixed-bucket hash map with insert, lookup and delete. Each bucket is a list of key-value pairs.
code: raise ValueError("need at least one bucket")
triggers: distinct keys land in the same hash bucket
update a key without duplicating it
prompts: Two badge IDs land in the same storage bucket. Retrieve each badge owner independently.
Maintain a small keyed index whose entries can be updated and withdrawn.
invariant: Each key appears once in the bucket chosen by its hash.
mantra: Hash to a bucket, then compare keys.
pitfalls: A fixed bucket count allows chains to grow. Resize a production table to keep its load factor bounded.

anchors.name: Design HashMap
anchors.trick: Separate chaining preserves keys that collide.

complexity.time: Expected O(1 + n/b) for n keys in b buckets under uniform hashing, O(n) worst case

mutations.explanation: Confuses two different keys in the same bucket.
